assertions.name: date-structure
assertions.target: report.json shape with verdict, checked_dates and per-date flags

assertions.name: date-valid-kept
assertions.target: real calendar dates kept flagged valid=true with no invented dates

rationale: The task card requires validating every batch_dates entry in delivery.json and flagging non-calendar dates false and real dates true. The pack input gives three dates, of which 2027-13-09 has an impossible month 13 while the April and August dates are real. The pack leaves underdetermined the verdict string value, date format normalization, and ordering of flags.
